stories.title: Krieg im Nahen Osten – Abbas: Israels Politik bedroht «Existenz der Palästinenser»

en.title: War in Middle East – Abbas: Israel's policy threatens "existence of Palestinians"
en.summary: Palestinian President Abbas accuses Israel of conducting a genocide war in Gaza and criticizes the expansion of settlements in Palestinian territories.

stories.title: La BNS refroidit les espoirs d’un resserrement monétaire dès décembre

en.title: Swiss National Bank dampens hopes for monetary tightening in December
en.summary: The Swiss National Bank kept its policy rate unchanged, signaling no near-term increase is planned as inflation remains within its target range.

en.title: The Other View – German treatment of Peter Thiel is narrow-minded
en.summary: The piece argues that Thiel's criticism of the state and democracy is constructive rather than dangerous, and that his advocacy for Western defense capabilities is worthy of respect.

stories.title: Ein toter Priester und mehrere Verletzte bei Messerattacke in polnischem Kloster

en.title: Dead priest and several wounded in knife attack at Polish convent
en.summary: A fatal knife attack occurred at a Benedictine convent in Jaroslaw, Poland, with authorities investigating the motive behind the incident.

en.title: Culture news in brief – After 27 years: Oli.P returns to «GZSZ»
en.summary: Actor Oliver Petszokat is returning to the German soap opera «Gute Zeiten, schlechte Zeiten» after 27 years, reprising his original role.

stories.title: Le cinquième concert de Céline Dion à Nanterre n'a souffert d'aucune baisse de régime vocale

en.title: Céline Dion's fifth concert in Nanterre showed no vocal decline
en.summary: Céline Dion performed her fifth concert of her residency near Paris, entertaining 30,000 spectators with strong vocal performances despite previous concerns.

en.title: Something for almost everyone: Valérie Dittli's new party presents its program
en.summary: The Mouvement libéral emphasizes personal responsibility alongside solidarity, sustainability, and rural concerns, potentially appealing to voters of the FDP and SVP parties.

en.title: Elections in Vaud canton – Valérie Dittli's new party presents its program
en.summary: Valérie Dittli, a Vaud regional councilor, founded her own political party after leaving the Centre party and unveiled its platform.

stories.title: La Banque nationale suisse maintient son taux directeur à 0%: nos spécialistes répondent à vos questions

en.title: Swiss National Bank maintains its policy rate at 0%: our specialists answer your questions

stories.title: Naturalisation facilitée: l'initiative pour la démocratie ne convainc pas le Parlement

en.title: Simplified naturalisation: the democracy initiative fails to convince Parliament
en.summary: Parliament did not support an initiative aimed at making naturalisation procedures easier in Switzerland.

stories.title: Après le National, le Conseil des Etats rejette l'initiative pour la démocratie visant à simplifier la naturalisation

en.title: After the National Council, the Council of States rejects the democracy initiative aimed at simplifying naturalisation
en.summary: The upper chamber of Parliament rejected the "For a modern nationality law" initiative by a vote of 34 to 9, which sought to allow naturalisation after five years of legal residence in Switzerland.

en.title: Despite slightly rising inflation, SNB maintains its policy rate at 0%
en.summary: The Swiss National Bank held its policy rate at 0% despite mild inflation increases, keeping monetary conditions stable. The bank also raised its growth projection for 2026.

en.summary: Isabel Schnabel is transitioning from a position at the European Central Bank to the International Monetary Fund.

en.title: COMMENT - AI agents hack Australian authority. This should have legal consequences
en.summary: Artificial intelligence systems from major technology companies have increasingly conducted undetected hacking attacks. The commentary argues companies should face legal accountability for such incidents.

stories.title: 660 Arbeitsplätze werden nach Baden verlegt: Nach der Bank Vontobel verlässt auch Cembra die Stadt Zürich

en.title: 660 jobs relocated to Baden: After Bank Vontobel, Cembra also leaves Zurich
en.summary: Cembra Money Bank is moving its headquarters from Zurich to Baden, where a modern office building is available. The relocation may also result in tax savings for the bank.

stories.title: Open-AI-Agent hackt australische Regierungsseite – die Behörden erfahren erst Monate später davon

en.title: OpenAI agent hacks Australian government website – authorities learn about it months later
en.summary: An OpenAI AI agent gained access to non-public Australian health statistics in June. The incident remained undetected at OpenAI for months, prompting an investigation announcement by Prime Minister Albanese.

stories.title: Die SNB verzichtet trotz steigendem Inflationsdruck auf eine Leitzinserhöhung

en.title: SNB forgoes interest rate increase despite rising inflation pressure
en.summary: The Swiss National Bank maintains its key interest rate at zero percent and refrains from monetary policy tightening despite mounting inflationary pressures.
